description:
File: pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs:162

smime_policy sets require_subject_alt_name = true with the intent of enforcing 'rfc822Name SAN required for Mailbox-validated' (doc comment). However, the enforcement in pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1987 only checks that the SAN extension is present and non-empty — it does not check that any entry is an Rfc822Name.

A TLS certificate with SAN=DNS:example.com and EKU=emailProtection would pass smime_policy's SAN check, violating the S/MIME BR §7.3 requirement that the certificate must contain an rfc822Name in the SubjectAltName.

Contract violation: the doc comment says 'rfc822Name SAN required for Mailbox-validated' but the implementation only enforces 'non-empty SAN'.

Fix options:
1. Add an rfc822Name check to ValidationPolicy (new field: require_rfc822_san) and set it in smime_policy.
2. Document the limitation explicitly: 'this policy requires a non-empty SAN extension but does not verify that the SAN contains an rfc822Name — full Mailbox-validated enforcement requires a separate rfc822Name check.'

Option 2 is a scope-limited workaround; option 1 is the correct fix for v0.1 if S/MIME is a declared use case.
title: smime_policy SAN check doesn't verify rfc822Name — DNS SAN would pass
